answer_4.quote: To further understand the impact of our algorithm on end users, we conduct human evaluations of explanations from our method and the two top baselines -IG and GradShap. We perform the study on the DistilBERT model fine-tuned on SST2 dataset and the BERT model fine-tuned on Rotten Tomatoes dataset.
answer_4.guideline: We show the highlighted sentence and the model's predicted label to the annotators and ask them to rank the explanations on a scale of 1-3, "1" being the most comprehensive explanation that best justifies the prediction.
